Local IP address of the WeatherLink Live: Local IP address of the WeatherLink Live device, e.g. 192.168.1.50
Searches the local network for a Weather: Searches the local network for a WeatherLink Live via mDNS/Bonjour and fills in its IP address and port automatically
No WeatherLink Live found on the local n: No WeatherLink Live found on the local network. Make sure the device and this ioBroker host are on the same network and multicast is not blocked, then enter the IP address manually.
Discovery failed, see the adapter log fo: Discovery failed, see the adapter log for details.
Minimum 10 seconds as required by the We: Minimum 10 seconds as required by the WeatherLink Live Local API
The WeatherLink Live always reports valu: The WeatherLink Live always reports values in imperial units; select "Metric" to convert temperature (°C), wind speed (km/h) and pressure (hPa) before storing them
Cloud cover and the current weather icon: Cloud cover and the current weather icon are estimated from a solar radiation sensor (if present), using this ioBroker installation's location (Admin -> System settings). Without a configured location or a solar sensor, a rougher estimate based on dew point (and pressure trend, if a barometer is present) is used instead. If neither is possible, no cloud cover or weather icon value is created.
Requests the WeatherLink Live to broadca: Requests the WeatherLink Live to broadcast wind and rain data every 2.5s over UDP
Duration requested per activation; will: Duration requested per activation; will be renewed automatically. Max 86400
